comment: Areas that ISO 3166 codes twice: a country code (3166-1) and a subdivision code of another country (3166-2). DPV Locations 2.3 lists both codes as concepts. same_area: the extension identifies them, so they sit in one identity class. excluded: the extension lists both and identifies nothing, so listing both under the ISO distinctness rule would declare one area distinct from itself; the subdivision code is left out of dpvloc-iso and the scope condition names it. different_areas: a country and a subdivision of another country that share a name and are two areas. check_declarations.py fails on a pair of that kind that appears in none of the three.
